image.prompt: Painterly illustration in a 70/30 style blend: primarily (70%) the atmospheric, painterly style of the animated series Scavengers Reign — muted naturalistic palette, organic textures, soft volumetric haze and lighting, subtle bioluminescent color accents — blended with (30%) the warm, soft style of Studio Ghibli background art. Gentle brushwork, soft diffused light, calm and cozy mood, no harsh shadows. No text, no logos, no watermark. Tuesday, a 3-year-old girl with a short blonde bob haircut with a soft fringe, rosy cheeks and a small button nose. She looks clearly three, not a baby: a slightly slimmer face that has lost most of its baby chubbiness, longer legs and a taller, steadier standing posture, proportions of a preschooler rather than an infant. She wears a simple cream sweater and stands on a grassy coastal headland, seen from slightly behind at three-quarter view, looking out at the ocean. Middle-right background: a white lighthouse with a red-roofed lamp room on the point, its window glowing warm gold, a soft beam of light in the air. Dusk blue-hour sky, deep indigo and soft lavender clouds, calm rolling waves below the cliff catching the last light. Tuesday in the lower third, generous sky above. Horizontal 16:9 landscape composition.

video.prompt: The lighthouse beam sweeps smoothly and steadily across the sky, one full sweep that ends where it began. Ocean waves roll gently and rhythmically below the cliff in a steady swell. Clouds drift almost imperceptibly. Tuesday stands still; only a light sway of her hair in the sea breeze. Calm, ambient dusk. Locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Slow, continuous, cyclical, steady-state motion only — nothing that builds, changes pose, or tells a story. Lighting and color held constant throughout. The final frame returns exactly to the starting image so the clip loops seamlessly. No text, no captions, no audio.
video.negative_prompt: camera movement, zoom, pan, cuts, scene change, lighting change, new characters, text, subtitles, morphing faces, extra limbs
video.audio_note: Veo 3.1 always generates audio; build_loop.py discards it
